searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he mission room websocket admission the awtsmoos renews ticket, account, origin, permission, protocol, and handshake in one gate; awtsmoos.com consumes trust before the socket opens, so stale authority cannot simply ride remembered state. websocket path /api/tunnel/control/mission room/ws this path is handled specially during websocket upgrade by ayzarim/awtsmoosdynamicserver/websocket/apps/missionrooms/upgradepolicy.js. it is not an ordinary json endpoint even though it begins with /api/. admission sequence observed in source 1. parse the requested url. if it is not the mission room path, mission room policy does not own the upgrade. 2. require sec websocket key; otherwise deny with 400 missing websocket key. 3. require trusted socket identity with accountid; otherwise deny with 401 mission room authentication required. 4. canonicalize and require the request origin; otherwise deny with 403 missing websocket origin. 5. build claims from url, origin, and trusted identity. 6. consume the one time ticket from query parameter ticket. 7. re authorize the current account/tunnel against tunnel.mission. 8. require the consumed ticket's authority to match current authority. 9. require the claim protocol version to equal room protocol version; mismatch is denied with 409 mission room protocol version mismatch. 10. only then return an accepted ticket to the socket upgrade layer. after successful handshake socketupgrade.js attaches the client and starts the mission room channel when an accepted ticket exists. connection activity is published with channel mission room, mission id, and room id. security implications a url containing a ticket is not enough by itself. admission also binds to trusted account identity, current mission permission, canonical origin, and protocol version. the ticket is consumed rather than treated as a permanent bearer credential. http relationship tunnel control has http routes for mission room streams/control alongside the websocket path. use ../api/tunnel control.md for the http control plane; keep socket admission/protocol logic separate.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he ui/ux revelation sweep — discovery breadth the awtsmoos renews every visible interface each instant; this notebook treats each screen as a vessel, not an excuse to redesign what already works. awtsmoos.com is the field of manifestation: improve only where evidence reveals friction, breakage, clutter, inaccessible stacking, invalid layering, mobile failure, or confused interaction. mission audit the complete geelooy surface across pages, apps, games, overlays, menus, dialogs, editors, dashboards, and responsive states. preserve established working patterns. repair only actual ui/ux defects and high confidence structural risks. evidence hierarchy 1. runtime screenshots and dom state. 2. browser console and layout measurements. 3. real route/component/style relationships in source. 4. existing tests and documented behavior. 5. static inference only when runtime proof is unavailable. discovery categories invalid or conflicting z index / stacking contexts. clipped dialogs, menus, tooltips, dropdowns, toasts, and huds. mobile overflow, fixed width layouts, unreachable controls, tiny targets. excessive density, overlapping controls, unreadable contrast, cramped typography. broken focus, tab order, missing visible focus, keyboard traps. touch/hover mismatch and controls that depend on hover only. viewport height assumptions that fail on mobile browser chrome. safe area failures on notched devices. scroll lock failures and nested scroll dead zones. game huds that obscure play, status, or core controls. responsive navigation failures and hidden actions. inconsistent component spacing that materially harms comprehension. modals exceeding viewport or lacking usable close paths. canvas/game scaling that creates letterboxing, clipping, or unusable controls. fixed position elements fighting each other. low information clutter that blocks primary actions. preserve first rules no aesthetic redesign without a concrete issue. no public contract breakage. no broad global css rewrite unless a verified shared defect justifies it. prefer local, reusable fixes at the correct abstraction boundary. verify desktop and mobile after every affected surface. if a page is already coherent, leave it alone. ideal world possibilities a perfect sweep could inventory every route, capture desktop/mobile screenshots, measure overlays, locate every stacking context, inspect every game hud, detect horizontal overflow automatically, trace shared styles to consumers, and attach regression checks for every repaired defect. reality boundary the practical path is evidence led sampling plus source wide structural scanning: discover route/app/game universe, identify shared layout primitives and obvious anti patterns, inspect suspect surfaces in browser, make bounded fixes, then regression test affected families and shared primitives. completion evidence the work is complete only when the route/app/game inventory is covered, discovered real defects are fixed, modified source is re read, relevant checks pass, runtime verification shows no regressions, and remaining high confidence ui/ux work is empty or explicitly blocked by unavailable runtime paths.
